title.narrative: Engaging civil society towards inclusive sustainable development in Egypt

description.narrative: The action aims to contribute to the EU global objective to strengthen the role of Civil Society Organizations (CSOs) as governance and development actors in Egypt (OO) through better equipping CSOs in Upper Egypt Governorates to play an active role in addressing sustainable development challenges in an inclusive and participatory manner (SO). The action will address the capacity constraints that Egyptian CSOs are facing in order to empower them as key actors in local governance and sustainable development, with a focus on participatory approaches and social inclusion of disadvantaged population groups. Three components are envisaged: (Op1) strengthening the organizational and operational capacities of CSOs through a tailored and continuous learning program; (Op2) equipping CSOs to carry out initiatives addressing their communities¿ social, environmental and economic needs; (Op3) showcasing the work of CSOs among them, to their communities, to private sector actors and public institutions.
